player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent bilong yu i ({opp}). Salim move olsem '[b1 c3]' (long → go). Olgeta pisi i go olsem knight bilong chess.
Kiap kisim {score_per_capture} point long kisim wanpela pisi. Gem i pinis bihain {max_moves} move o taim wanpela player i no gat laik move / no pisi. Skor i win i go antap.

invalid_move.bad_format: Pasin bilong raitim ol tok i no stret. Yusim '[b1 c3]'.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: As bilong piksa i no bilong yu.
invalid_move.own_piece: I no ken lusim pisa bilong yu yet long ples bilong pisa bilong yu.
invalid_move.not_knight: I no ken wokim muv bilong saksok.

game_action.moved: Pleeya {player_id} imuvim peis bilong em from {frm} go long {to}.

outcome.move_limit: Ol i no inap mekim moa.
